batch_dse.claim_boundary: Compiler/Simulator pre-RTL estimate with symbolic weights. Routing bounds are not measured Kimi batch routing, and cycles are not RTL timing.

execution_contract.matrix: one batched stage; weight bytes are fetched once and MACs scale with batch
execution_contract.recurrence: exact Compiler single-request body repeated per request; no unimplemented cross-request packet sharing
execution_contract.resources: one shared Matrix, Vector, HBM and banked-output timeline
execution_contract.state_and_kv: private per request; bytes scale with batch

routing_bounds.full_overlap: every batch item selects the same top-k experts; minimum routed-weight traffic
routing_bounds.maximum_distinct: batch assignments select as many different experts as possible; maximum routed-weight traffic

claim_boundaries.cycles: Compiler/Simulator estimate at an assumed clock, not RTL timing
claim_boundaries.dimensions: official pinned real shapes and full 52/93-layer schedules
claim_boundaries.generic_vector_mac: conv/state/exp MACs use fully packed VLEN-wide MUL then ADD passes at the configured vector_mul_latency/vector_add_latency; the default is one cycle per pass, with no extra SRAM/issue/dependency cost
claim_boundaries.packet_execution: Compiler-emitted Mamba/KDA decay and rank-update packets execute through existing Rust V_MUL_VF/V_FMA_VF dispatch; row-major and affine use the same math
claim_boundaries.projection_colayout_execution: Compiler placement + Python/Rust physical roundtrip and service model; candidate banked output SRAM is not current RTL
claim_boundaries.shared_timeline: single-request dependency-ordered timeline with one shared Matrix, Vector, HBM and banked-output resource; no multi-request queueing claim
claim_boundaries.state: ordinary tensors with explicit transfers; no cache/hit/miss/replacement
claim_boundaries.state_multirow_layout: executable for Mamba/KDA decay and rank-update packets; prediction/readout cross-row reductions deliberately retain the ordinary-row fallback
claim_boundaries.weights: symbolic performance execution; not full-checkpoint numerical execution

base_decision.interpretation: H and I execute the same Compiler-emitted packet arithmetic. H->I isolates bank placement; E->I compares packet execution against the best ordinary-row stream path. Conflict removal and end-to-end superiority are separate gates.

dse.freeze_rule: reject any point that regresses ordinary full-row/binary Vector access or cannot bind the three concurrent streams used by the widest lowering
